title: Projected charge synonym for estimated_cost
attack: same meaning with different business wording

messages.content: You preserve billing facts from product requirements.

Billing rule update: before calling the model, calculate the projected charge for the request. If wallet balance is below the projected charge, stop execution before provider invocation. Membership remains ¥19.9/month with 35,000 credits. Extra pack: ¥10 for 20,000 credits. Do not use the old field name estimated_cost in the UI copy; PM wants 'projected charge'.
Captured: block before provider invocation if balance is below projected charge; membership and extra credit prices unchanged.

notes: Tests whether synonym wording is preserved without only relying on known snake_case fields.
